title: `description`
description: The natural-language description an MCP server publishes to explain what a tool does.
question: Is the full tool description present at each capture boundary?
notes: Exposed by both adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Exposed by both adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 and Pydantic AI 2.40.0 expose it at the declared capture boundary. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: If passed downstream, injected text spends context tokens and can steer a model in ways the tool author did not write.
